articles.title: Car Ramming & Assault Chaos in Dehradun: 4 Arrested After Viral Video Exposes Rampage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident of violence and reckless driving has surfaced from Sahaspur in Dehradun, where a group of youths allegedly created chaos at Dharmawala Chowk. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A disturbing incident of violence and reckless driving has surfaced from Sahaspur in Dehradun, where a group of youths allegedly created chaos at Dharmawala Chowk. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

According to police, the incident took place late Sunday night in the Vikasnagar area, where miscreants reportedly drove a car recklessly into a crowd, causing panic among locals. The video shows the vehicle being driven dangerously towards people.

Amid the chaos, a youth identified as Ravindra Singh, a resident of Shahpur Kalyanpur (Dharmawala), was allegedly assaulted by a group. Police said four individuals were beating him when officers reached the spot after receiving information about the disturbance.

Sahaspur police acted swiftly and arrested four accused on the spot. The arrested have been identified as Ikram (36), Vishal Goyal (32), Shahrukh (26), and Arshad (26).

The vehicle used in the incident has been seized. Police have registered a case under sections related to assault, abuse, dangerous driving, and damage to property.

Officials stated that although several people were put at risk, one youth narrowly escaped without injury despite falling during the incident.

Police said further investigation is underway, and strict action will be taken against all those involved.

articles.title: Aligarh Constable Accused of Assaulting Rape Victim Seeking Justice, Suspended
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a disturbing case from Aligarh, a police constable has been accused of sexually exploiting a woman who had approached authorities with a rape complaint.

body.html:
In a disturbing case from Aligarh, a police constable has been accused of sexually exploiting a woman who had approached authorities with a rape complaint.

The incident pertains to the Quarsi police station area, where the victim alleged that head constable Imran Khan, posted at the Nagla Patwari outpost, demanded sexual favours in exchange for taking action on her complaint.

According to the victim, she had filed a complaint against a man named Zeeshan on the Chief Minister’s portal, accusing him of rape on the pretext of marriage. During the course of inquiry, the accused constable allegedly contacted her via WhatsApp, asked for private photos, and pressured her to meet him at a hotel under the pretext of buying Eid clothes.

The woman further alleged that the constable used intimidation and religious references to coerce her, threatening that no action would be taken in her case unless she complied. He also allegedly warned her against disclosing the matter.

The victim later approached the Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP), submitting an audio recording as evidence, which reportedly contains incriminating conversations.

Taking swift action, SSP Aligarh suspended the accused constable and directed that an FIR be registered under relevant sections. A departmental inquiry has also been initiated.

Police officials stated that strict action, including dismissal, will follow if the accuse is found guilty.

The incident has sparked serious concerns over accountability within law enforcement, particularly when those tasked with delivering justice are themselves accused of grave misconduct.

#Aligarh #UPPolice #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #PoliceMisconduct

articles.title: Beer on Ganga Banks Sparks Confrontation: Tourist Apologises After Locals Intervene in Rishikesh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An incident of unruly behaviour by a tourist has come to light from the Laxman Jhula area of Rishikesh, where a man was seen consuming beer on the banks of the Ganges, triggering protests from local youth.

body.html:
An incident of unruly behaviour by a tourist has come to light from the Laxman Jhula area of Rishikesh, where a man was seen consuming beer on the banks of the Ganges, triggering protests from local youth.

According to reports, locals objected to the act, stating that the Ganges is a sacred river and such behaviour is disrespectful. One of the youths, identified as Ankit Gupta, confronted the tourist and urged him to maintain the sanctity of the place.

In a surprising response, the tourist claimed he was unaware that he was near the Ganges, drawing disbelief from the locals, who pointed out that the river was clearly visible.

The situation, however, did not escalate. The youths handled the matter calmly, took the empty beer can from the tourist, disposed of it responsibly, and ensured he left the area without further trouble.

The tourist later admitted his mistake and apologised before quietly leaving the spot. Locals have appreciated the measured response, saying it sends a strong message about respecting religious and cultural sentiments at such sites.

A video of the incident has gone viral on social media, highlighting both the misconduct and the responsible handling of the situation by local residents.

articles.title: Death Toll Hits 66 in Colombian Air Force C-130 Crash; Dozens Missing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: PUERTO LEGUÍZAMO – A horrific aviation disaster struck Colombia on Monday morning when an Air Force C-130 Hercules crashed shortly after takeoff from Caucayá Airport. The death toll has officially risen to 66, with many still missing in the dense jungle of the Putumayo department.

body.html:
PUERTO LEGUÍZAMO – A horrific aviation disaster struck Colombia on Monday morning when an Air Force C-130 Hercules crashed shortly after takeoff from Caucayá Airport. The death toll has officially risen to 66, with many still missing in the dense jungle of the Putumayo department.

The aircraft (registration FAC1016) was transporting 114 National Army soldiers and 11 crew members—a total of 125 people. Moments after departure, the plane reportedly struck a tree and plummeted approximately 2 km from the runway. A massive fire immediately engulfed the wreckage, worsened by the detonation of onboard ammunition and explosives.

Local residents were the first on the scene, using motorcycles to evacuate the 59 known survivors to nearby hospitals. President Gustavo Petro has sparked a political firestorm following the crash, blaming bureaucratic delays for the failure to modernize the aging military fleet. Investigations into the technical failure are ongoing.

articles.title: ‘Fake IAS’ Marries 25 Times? Gorakhpur Family Alleges ₹15 Lakh Fraud, Daughter’s Life Ruined
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged fraud and deception has emerged from Gorakhpur, where a man posing as an IAS officer is accused of marrying multiple women and extorting money from families.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged fraud and deception has emerged from Gorakhpur, where a man posing as an IAS officer is accused of marrying multiple women and extorting money from families.

The victim’s father, who is partially paralysed and bedridden, has alleged that the accused, identified as Pritam Kumar Nishad, duped his family by posing as a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and married his daughter after taking ₹15 lakh under the pretext of wedding expenses.

How the Trap Was Set
According to the family, the proposal came through a community group where Nishad’s profile claimed he was a 32-year-old IAS officer posted in Manikpur. The profile stated that no dowry was required, which convinced the family to proceed.

The accused later visited Gorakhpur in December 2025 and finalised the match. The family also travelled to Etawah to verify details, where Nishad showed them a house in Ludhiyat Mohalla and claimed to live there with his sister.

However, just before the wedding, he allegedly demanded ₹15 lakh, citing expenses for hosting “VIP guests”.

Wedding and Growing Suspicion
The marriage was held on March 11, 2026, at a marriage hall in the Cantt area. The accused arrived in a car bearing a “Government of India” label and was accompanied by an assistant, further strengthening his claims.

During the ceremony, some relatives grew suspicious as he failed to give clear answers about his posting and background. Despite this, the wedding rituals were completed, and the bride’s farewell took place on March 12.

Truth Comes Out
Soon after, the family began receiving calls from people in the accused’s village, who claimed that Nishad was not an IAS officer and had a history of fraud. They alleged he had married multiple times—reportedly up to 25—by deceiving families.

Alarmed, the bride’s family rushed to Etawah, where they confronted the accused. Under questioning, he allegedly admitted that he was not an IAS officer and had taken leave from a private job to carry out the marriage.

The family also claimed that the house he showed lacked basic amenities, further exposing his false claims.

Police Action
A complaint has been filed at Ekdil Police Station in Etawah, where police reportedly found that at least two other cases had already been registered against the accused. Another complaint has been lodged in Gorakhpur.

SSP Dr. Kaustubh confirmed that a case has been registered and an investigation is underway. “Appropriate action will be taken after verifying the allegations,” he said.

The victim’s father has vowed to pursue justice, stating he will not rest until the accused is punished for ruining his daughter’s life.

#Gorakhpur #FakeIAS #FraudCase #MarriageScam #BreakingNews

articles.title: Affair Turns Deadly: Daughter-in-Law, Lover Kill 69-Year-Old Woman in Lucknow; CCTV Switched Off
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking murder case from Lucknow’s Mahanagar area, a 36-year-old woman and her lover have been arrested for allegedly killing her 69-year-old mother-in-law, who opposed their relationship. The deceased, Nirmala Devi, was found dead at her residence in Nishatganj Gali No.

body.html:
In a shocking murder case from Lucknow’s Mahanagar area, a 36-year-old woman and her lover have been arrested for allegedly killing her 69-year-old mother-in-law, who opposed their relationship.

The deceased, Nirmala Devi, was found dead at her residence in Nishatganj Gali No. 3 on Saturday afternoon. According to police, her hands and feet were tied with rope, and she was strangled to death.

The accused have been identified as Ranjana Verma and her lover Rajan Sharma (21), an Ola taxi driver who had been living as a tenant in the same house. Police said the two were in a relationship for nearly four years, which had led to frequent disputes within the family.

How the Crime Unfolded
Investigations revealed that the accused deliberately switched off the CCTV cameras inside the house between 2 pm and 4 pm to avoid suspicion. During this time, they allegedly tied up Nirmala Devi and strangled her, reportedly using a saree. They also attempted to mislead investigators by later turning the CCTV back on remotely using a mobile phone and fleeing the scene.

Around 4 pm, the victim’s grandson, Aditya (18), returned home and found his grandmother lying unconscious with her hands and legs bound. He raised an alarm and informed his father and mother. Fearing suspicion, Ranjana and Rajan returned home and staged a robbery narrative.

Ranjana reportedly began crying and claimed that unknown persons had entered the house, robbed valuables, and killed her mother-in-law.

Police Investigation and Arrests
However, inconsistencies emerged during the investigation. CCTV footage from outside the house showed Ranjana leaving with Rajan during the crucial period. A sniffer dog also reportedly led police towards Rajan, raising further suspicion.

Upon interrogation, Rajan allegedly confessed to the crime, stating that they planned the murder as Nirmala Devi opposed their relationship and had recently argued with Ranjana.

Based on a complaint filed by the victim’s son, Tridesh Verma, police registered an FIR against both accused. They were arrested and sent to jail on Sunday.

SHO Metropolitan Akhilesh Mishra confirmed that the murder was premeditated, and further investigation is underway. Police have also recovered evidence and are probing additional aspects, including the alleged theft of ornaments.

The incident has sent shockwaves in the locality, with residents expressing concern over the brutality of the crime.

articles.title: ORR Horror Near Narsingi: Late MLA Maganti Gopinath’s Daughters Injured in High-Speed Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tragic road accident on Hyderabad’s Outer Ring Road (ORR), the two daughters of late Jubilee Hills MLA Maganti Gopinath were injured after their car rammed into a stationary DCM vehicle near Narsingi on Sunday night, March 22, 2026.

body.html:
In a tragic road accident on Hyderabad’s Outer Ring Road (ORR), the two daughters of late Jubilee Hills MLA Maganti Gopinath were injured after their car rammed into a stationary DCM vehicle near Narsingi on Sunday night, March 22, 2026.

According to police, the accident occurred on the Narsingi stretch near the Police Academy/Greyhounds area while the group was travelling between Gachibowli and Shamshabad airport. The car, reportedly moving at high speed, lost control—possibly after a wheel skid or mechanical issue—and crashed into a DCM truck that had halted on the carriageway after reportedly losing its rear wheels.

Injuries and Victims

Akshara Nag (elder daughter): Sustained serious injuries; some reports describe her condition as critical.
Sisira (younger daughter): Suffered minor injuries.
Other passengers: Two friends travelling with them were also injured.

All four were immediately shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment.

Police said the impact caused significant disruption, with multiple lanes on the ORR briefly blocked, leading to heavy traffic congestion. Cyberabad Traffic Police later cleared the damaged vehicles with the help of cranes and restored normal traffic flow.

Police Action
Narsingi police have registered a case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, including Section 125(A) related to endangering life due to negligence. Preliminary findings indicate overspeeding as a key factor, though a detailed investigation is underway to determine the exact cause.

Authorities are examining all angles, including vehicle condition and sequence of events leading to the crash.

#Hyderabad #ORR #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #Telangana

articles.title: 70-Year-Old Madrasa Maulana Caught on Video Molesting 11-Year-Old Boy: POCSO Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh: Police arrested 70-year-old Maulana Iqbal from Islamia Madrasa in Shahpur area for sexually assaulting an 11-year-old boy. A video of the incident, allegedly recorded on Eid night of March 21, went viral, leading to the complaint.

body.html:
Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh: Police arrested 70-year-old Maulana Iqbal from Islamia Madrasa in Shahpur area for sexually assaulting an 11-year-old boy. A video of the incident, allegedly recorded on Eid night of March 21, went viral, leading to the complaint.

The minor, a student at the madrasa for five years, told his family that Iqbal would detain him after Urdu classes on the pretext of work or cleaning, take him to another room, and assault him while issuing threats. In the 1:59-minute video, Iqbal is seen nude, forcing himself on the boy who was lying on the bed and resisting.

Based on the father's complaint, a case was registered under POCSO and other sections.

Iqbal was arrested late Sunday night and sent to jail. The madrasa is located 25 km from district headquarters, where he had been teaching for 40 years.

SP Rural Aditya Bansal said the video clearly shows the Maulana sexually assaulting the minor student, and strictest punishment will be ensured.

articles.title: Drunk Man Wields Mace, Confronts Police on Bengaluru Road; Viral Video Raises Safety Concerns
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has emerged from Kanakapura in the Bengaluru South district, where a drunken man was seen brandishing a mace and creating chaos on a public road, even confronting police personnel.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has emerged from Kanakapura in the Bengaluru South district, where a drunken man was seen brandishing a mace and creating chaos on a public road, even confronting police personnel.

According to reports, the man, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, was roaming on the street holding the weapon and threatening passersby. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media, showing him behaving aggressively and showing no fear even in the presence of police.

The incident has raised serious concerns about public safety, as such behaviour poses a direct threat to pedestrians and motorists. Witnesses said the man’s actions created panic in the area, with people keeping their distance to avoid harm.

Officials have not yet released detailed information on whether the accused has been arrested or charged. However, the incident has sparked debate over rising instances of reckless and unlawful behaviour in public spaces.

Authorities are expected to take strict action, as carrying weapons and causing public disturbance under the influence of alcohol is a serious offence.

The episode serves as a reminder of the risks posed by irresponsible behaviour in public and the importance of enforcing law and order to ensure citizen safety.
